item.title: The Black Race and the Leadership Question: Covenant University Celebrates Dr. David Oyedepo’s Vision at 70
item.description: "Africa’s leadership problem is not political but intellectual. We must develop our own model of education—one that is contribution-driven and focused on addressing the unique challenges that confront us." — Dr. David Oyedepo
